description: FIG ACRO Table of Difficulty 2025-2028, Women's Group balance: top positions on printed pages 54-57 (PDF 57-60). Tables 1, 2, 6, 7, 9, 10, 12, 13 are wheels (positions A-G, some tables lack one letter; static values from the grey circles); 3, 4, 5, 8, 11, 14, 15 are small tables (numbered boxes, 'Gr. 1-2-3-4' strip). `values` = top value for base groups 1-4 (null = not possible). Each table's `support` entries are its drawings, one per drawing, each with its point of support (`support`: the coach's name for it, e.g. "Dos manos", "Dos pies", "Una mano baja", "Otros"); almost every top position can be done on any of the table's supports with the same value, except where a position lists `notOnSupport`. The selector (still to build) will offer a support only if the chosen base allows it. Boxes with several drawings list them as `options` (one per drawing). Reviewed by the coach 2026-11-14. Wheel tables also list `motions` (the arrows): a motion X->Y (id "54/Tab1 - A->D") takes the white circles at the Y end of its arrow, `values` for base groups 1-4; motions to or from a position the table lacks are left out. Motions were read from the PDF's vector drawing (scripts/tod-wg-motions) and reviewed by the coach 2026-11-14.
